subject: PO line validation, VAT reclaim workflow & vendor onboarding packet
messages:
From: Alicia Park <accounts@helionlogistics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@helionlogistics.com>
Date: 2026-05-17 08:12 PDT
Subject: Vendor registration + PO validation for upcoming invoices

Hi Markus,

Quick intro — I manage AP for Helion Logistics. We're about to send a monthly consolidated PO for the Redwood account (PO 78321) and need Redwood registered in our vendor portal before we can process payment. Two asks to unblock payment: 

1) Please register as a vendor in our portal (portal link below). We require a point of contact + remit banking details and an attachment of a sample invoice showing the PO reference on each line item.

2) Our AP team requires line-level PO validation for split-ledger invoices: each invoice line must include PO number, PO line id, and VAT amount per line for reclaim. If an invoice contains multiple tax jurisdictions, please include VAT breakdown per line.

Could you provide: the completed onboarding packet, a sample invoice XML that maps line items to PO lines, and confirmation who will receive remittance emails?

Portal link: https://helion-portal.com/vendor/register/ABCD1234
PO reference: PO 78321 (billing frequency: monthly consolidated)

Thanks — if you prefer a short call this week we can walk through the portal together.

Best,
Alicia Park
Accounts Payable, Helion Logistics

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (account lead) and Laura (finance ops) so we can coordinate the portal upload and confirm the invoice schema.

Actionable items from our side: 
- We'll complete the vendor registration in the Helion portal today and upload the AP packet.
- Attached is a sample invoice XML that shows line-to-PO mapping and per-line VAT tags (markus_invoice_sample_helion.xml). That file follows our current e-invoice schema but we've annotated the PO-line fields you asked for.
- Laura will confirm whether we can emit VAT per line for multiple jurisdictions and whether any header-level fallback is needed.

Marissa — can you confirm the Redwood remit email and banking profile we should upload (and whether we should enable AP notifications to accounts@redwood-payments.com)?

Alicia — we'll also add a PDF onboarding packet with required evidence (W-9 / VAT self-cert where applicable) and a short checklist for the portal. Expect the packet in the portal by EOD.

Thanks,
Markus

Date: 2026-05-18 09:15 PDT
Subject: RE: Vendor registration + PO validation for upcoming invoices

On Mon, May 17, 2026 at 11:40 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Markus: Attached is a sample invoice XML that shows line-to-PO mapping and per-line VAT tags.

Thanks — reviewed the XML and it's mostly aligned. Two items to flag for Helion so we don't get PO rejections: 

1) PO line identifier: Helion expects a stable 'lineSequenceId' value that is an integer per PO line. We can populate that from the invoice generator, but confirm which field in Helion's schema maps to it (they sometimes expect 'lineId' vs 'lineSequence').

2) VAT reclaim: For multi-jurisdiction invoices we'll embed a 'taxBreakdown' element per line with: taxType (VAT), taxRate, taxAmount, taxJurisdiction. If Helion prefers header-level VAT summary for consolidated POs, we can include both per-line and header summaries (duplicate but safe).

I've attached our onboarding packet (redwood-ap-onboarding-packet-v1.pdf) which includes: company legal name, VAT ids by entity, sample invoice XML, banking instruction stub, and primary remit contact. Markus/Marissa: confirm bank account ending in 5421 and remit email accounts@redwood-payments.com for upload.

Laura Bennett
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-ap-onboarding-packet-v1.pdf
From: Alicia Park <accounts@helionlogistics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@helionlogistics.com>, Helion AP Portal <no-reply@helion-portal.com>
Date: 2026-05-19 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO validation for upcoming invoices

Markus/Laura — thank you, this is great. Portal registration for Redwood is complete and shows vendor ID HNL-9072. I tested the sample XML and our ingest accepted the lineSequenceId and taxBreakdown elements. A couple of final clarifications before we close the ticket: 

• Please ensure every invoice includes PO 78321 in the invoice header and the matching PO number on each line. 
• For consolidated monthly invoices with split-ledger lines, include both per-line taxBreakdown and a header-level VAT summary (our AP expects the summary for reconciliation).
• Helion will send remittance advice to accounts@redwood-payments.com; payment runs are on the 15th of each month after validation.

If you can send one test invoice for June's cycle by June 2 (even a low-value test) we'll confirm acceptance and schedule payment the following cycle.

Thanks again — Alicia
Alicia Park
Accounts Payable, Helion Logistics
